Today, RSI still trains agents task by task.
现在的 RSI　还在逐个任务地训练智能体
We argue it should be capability-driven.
我们主张　转向能力驱动
Every agent runs on a Harness: six protocols around one frozen model.
每个智能体都跑在一套 Harness 上　六个协议　围绕一个冻结的模型
One Harness per task transfers poorly
每个任务一套　难以迁移
one global Harness can't reconcile conflicting demands.
全局只用一套　又顾不上相互冲突的需求
Yet tasks that look different often need the same capabilities.
可是　看起来不同的任务　往往需要同样的能力
ARC-AGI-3 and Micromouse both rely on perception and state tracking.
ARC-AGI-3 和 Micromouse　都依赖感知和状态追踪
Group tasks by what they share, and learning transfers.
按共享的能力组织任务　学到的就能迁移
This is The Trinity.
这就是 The Trinity
Three roles, one frozen model: Creator builds worlds, Explorer acts in them
三个角色　共用一个冻结的模型　Creator 造世界　Explorer 闯世界
and Evolver improves the Harness.
Evolver 改进 Harness
Stage one: forty-four benchmarks form a task tree.
第一阶段　44 个基准　组成一棵任务树
Explorer runs the base Harness on the training tasks and logs each run.
Explorer 用基础 Harness 把训练任务跑一遍　并记录每一次运行
Stage two: the runs reveal six capabilities, and tasks with the same needs share a node.
第二阶段　轨迹揭示出六种能力　需求相同的任务汇到同一个节点
Creator builds simplified, verifiable worlds for each node, where Explorer can practise.
Creator 为每个节点构建简化　可验证的世界　供 Explorer 练习
Stage three: as Explorer practises, reusable modules grow along the tree.
第三阶段　随着 Explorer 练习　可复用的模块沿树生长
Children inherit their parent's modules, and keep an update only if it strictly helps.
子节点继承父节点的模块　更新只有严格变好才保留
The model never changes. Only the Harness grows.
模型始终不变　变强的只是 Harness
For a new task
遇到新任务
the Router recalls verified experience and picks one Harness before acting.
Router 先调出已验证的经验　再选定一套 Harness
The result is written back to memory.
结果会写回经验记忆
Up 34.1 points on training benchmarks and 26.2 on unseen ones, two real robots included.
训练基准提升 34.1 分　未见基准提升 26.2 分　其中包括两台真实机器人
The Trinity. Grow capabilities, brick by brick.
The Trinity　按能力生长　一块一块搭起来
